title: Duel Decks: Izzet vs. Golgari: card flavor text

entities.name: Trivaz
entities.description: An Izzet mage who extols gelectrodes as pets.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A guild of mages and tinkers known for power-hungry, contradictory creations.

entities.name: Juzba
entities.description: An Izzet tinker who explains the blazekite.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane whose husk the Galvanoth chews open to feed on energy.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A 'wounded world' with searing blood spilling onto its surface.

entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: A speaker who warns of Jund's dangers.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon of the Izzet, whose genius and vanity fill Nivix and whose likeness shapes the Izzet signet.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A world where a sigil is both a prize of honor and a bond of duty.

entities.name: Dierk
entities.description: A geistmage who dispels abominations.

entities.name: Nivix
entities.description: The aerie of the Firemind, with mirrored halls.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: A speaker who views death as wringing away innocence.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The faction that cast out the elves of deep shadow generations ago.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A guild of the undercity that plants rather than buries its dead.

entities.name: Zul Ashur
entities.description: A lich lord who commands reassembling skeletons.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A world with an overabundant food supply.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: Home of the Mercadians, who throw the poor dead into a bog.

entities.name: the Ghoul's Larder
entities.description: A bog where Mercadians who cannot afford a tomb are thrown.

entities.name: Ezoc
entities.description: A Golgari rot farmer who speeds up decay.

entities.name: Chaeska
entities.description: The Keeper of Tresserhorn, who speaks of the benefits of death.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: A place kept by Chaeska.

entities.name: Halana of Ulvenwald
entities.description: A speaker from Ulvenwald who scorns vampires.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: Halana's home region.

entities.name: Necropolis
entities.description: A place bearing the inscription 'Twilight falls. We rise.'

events.summary: Elves of deep shadow, cast out of the Conclave generations ago, found a home in Golgari districts.
events.quote: Cast out of the Conclave generations ago, these elves found a home in the corrupted districts of the Golgari.

relations.quote: Niv-Mizzet's genius and vanity reverberate throughout the mirrored halls of Nivix.

relations.note: bog used by Mercadians for their poor dead
relations.quote: Mercadians not wealthy enough to buy a tomb are thrown into a bog called "the Ghoul's Larder."
